C1A vs C1 distinction (C1A stops at +3.65, C1 continues to +4.55) is new information not present in house 08's simpler single-tier C1 — this house's roof geometry (X-plan hip, not a simple gable) apparently needs two column heights at different grid positions.
Clean digital-print source, high confidence throughout except the CN contradiction (inherent to the source, not a legibility issue).
